logic.note: OUT LOW when an object is within threshold × surface reflectivity (white 1, grey 0.6, black 0.2), HIGH through the module's 10 kΩ pull-up otherwise.

timing.note: Switches instantly; the real comparator answers in well under 1 ms. No hysteresis, so an object right at the edge does not flicker here but may on hardware.

analog.note: The object is one distance (a prop, or the nearest hit of 3 rays over ±5° from the robot physics, up to 40 cm). No IR reflectance curve, ambient sunlight (which blinds it), angle of the surface or transparent objects.

power.note: 23 mA from VCC (IR LED + power LED) plus 3 mA for the obstacle LED; works from 3.0 V.

emulates: Shorter range on grey and black objects
Distance from the robot physics (raycast on its mount side)
doesNotEmulate: Sunlight and IR from lamps, which cause false or missed detections
Hysteresis and chatter at the edge of the range
testOnRealDevice: Set the knob on the real object at the real distance
Dark objects (often seen only at 1–3 cm)
